title: Roasted Vegetable Couscous
description: Roasted zucchini, peppers and chickpeas folded into lemony, herbed couscous.
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss zucchini, pepper and onion with olive oil and salt.
Roast vegetables on a tray 20–25 minutes, turning halfway through.
Bring broth to a boil; remove from heat, stir in couscous, cover and rest 5 minutes. Fluff.
Toss couscous with roasted vegetables, drained chickpeas, lemon juice and parsley.
